name: tour-vacation
description: Monorepo for Tour Vacation (Angular frontend + NestJS backend)

scripts.deploy:backend: npm run build:lambda && npm run cdk --workspace=infra -- deploy --profile tour-vacation --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:frontend: npm run build:frontend && aws s3 sync frontend/dist/frontend/browser s3://$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name TourVacationStack --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='FrontendBucketName'].OutputValue" --output text --profile tour-vacation) --delete --profile tour-vacation && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name TourVacationStack --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='DistributionId'].OutputValue" --output text --profile tour-vacation) --paths "/*" --profile tour-vacation
